name: Molnári (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Molnári: a blue and green shield with a mill, a church and a wavy stripe within a yellow baroque frame, below a scroll inscribed MOLNÁRI.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Molnári arms in a frame with scroll
